info.title: Bannerbite Universal API
info.description: Bannerbite auto-generates bite-sized images and videos from projects, bites, and render jobs through its public REST API.

post.description: Creates an image or video render job in Bannerbite.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

audio.description: Optional audio object containing url and inPoint.

email.description: Optional email address that receives the finished render.

scene.description: Required when type is image. Selects which scene to render.

sceneData.description: Array of scene variable objects to inject into the selected bite. Send each object with provider keys such as name, value, color, width, height, inPoint, outPoint, visibility, and position when applicable.

type.description: Render type. Bannerbite documents image, video, and overlay.

uid.description: The bite ID or bite access token used for the render request.

webhook.description: Optional webhook URL for render status notifications.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
